{{Top|leg}}
'''Glowcrystals''' were illumination devices used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. They were engraved with magnifying facets and mounted atop a pole. Lines of poles were used to line streets, providing illumination.<ref name="DA">[[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']]</ref> [[IC-M General Utility Droid]]s were tasked with replacing burnt-out glowcrystals.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
